visual_elements.description: ROC-style line plot on light blue background. X-axis labeled FPR with rightward arrow; Y-axis labeled TPR with upward arrow. Contains multiple colored curves: a purple/magenta curve hugging the top-left corner (best model), a green curve, a blue curve, and additional faint curves. A diagonal reference line runs from bottom-left to top-right. Light gray grid lines form a rectangular mesh. Two text annotations with arrows: 'Best Model Largest Area Under the Curve)' pointing to the upper-left purple curve, and 'Worst Model Smallest Area Under the Curve' pointing to a lower curve near the diagonal.
yellow circular badge with thin black outline containing the number 37

recreation_brief: 1. Create a white slide with a thin dark red border around the entire canvas. 2. Place the title 'Area Under the Curve (AUC)' at the top center in bold dark red (~#8B0000), large sans-serif. 3. Add a yellow circle at the top-right with black text '37'. 4. Below the title, add the subtitle 'Compare between different models (at different thresholds for each model)' in bold blue (~#0000FF); underline only the words 'different models'. 5. Add two lines of black body text: 'Best Model is the model trying to reach  the point at [FBR=0, TPR=1]' and 'In other words, Best model is the model that has the largest area under the curve'. 6. Insert a square plot area with a very light blue background (~#F0F8FF) centered in the lower half. 7. Draw black X and Y axes with arrowheads; label the X-axis 'FPR' and the Y-axis 'TPR'. 8. Add light gray grid lines. 9. Draw a diagonal line from bottom-left to top-right as the random baseline. 10. Draw a purple curve that rises steeply along the left edge and across the top (best model). 11. Draw additional colored curves (green, blue, etc.) that fall progressively closer to the diagonal. 12. Add the annotation 'Best Model Largest Area Under the Curve)' near the top with an arrow pointing to the purple curve. 13. Add the annotation 'Worst Model Smallest Area Under the Curve' on the right with an arrow pointing to the curve nearest the diagonal.
